items.text: The SIDE Exclusion Principle — Symmetry, Independence, Determination, Exhaustiveness.

The seven mechanism classes are proven exhaustive via Ostrowski's classification and the structure of ξ(s); no class produces the algebraic signature of an off-line zero; independence of the constraints forbids conspiracy among them; symmetry forces σ = 1/2 as the third identity element.
A skeptic can run lake build at the pinned kernel commit (SIDE-kernel v1.5 = 0e5233f) and #print axioms at the named route theorems (structural_exhaustiveness_proved;
Proved and machine-checked around the argument: the exhaustiveness of the seven-class catalogue over the places of ℚ;
Six companion papers: Exhaustive_Enumeration, Which_Structure_Confines, Spectral_Inertness, Third_Identity_Element, Silence_of_Foundations, Seven_Mechanism_Classes.
SIDE-kernel: Formal verification of the Riemann Hypothesis via exhaustive mechanism exclusion
The kernel proves that no off-line zero exists by exhaustively excluding every mechanism class derivable from the specification.
Companion manuscript: A Place to Stand — Seven papers on the Riemann Hypothesis via exhaustive mechanism exclusion (deposited separately).

At tag `v1.5` (`0e5233f`, route terminals re-profiled clean at the v1.5 enactment): `structural_exhaustiveness_proved` (Route 1), `SpectralCannonFull.spectral_cannon` (Route 2) and `ConservationBridge.riemann_hypothesis` (Route 3 — an INTERFACES terminal on the open premise `h2`, carried openly) compile with no `sorry` and depend on exactly `{propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}`;

**Federation:** ~45 further Lean kernels under [psinary-sketch](https://github.com/psinary-sketch) carry the arms — most recently [SIDE-window](https://github.com/psinary-sketch/SIDE-window) at tag `v0.5.0` (working head `aacb415`), the window arithmetic — *the terminal count quoted here previously was taken at `v0.2.0` and is not re-asserted at `v0.5.0`, which this pass did not audit*; and [SIDE-effects](https://github.com/psinary-sketch/SIDE-effects) (`afa9ccf`), the exclusion engine and the graded exhaustiveness ladder.

**On Route 1.** `structural_exhaustiveness_proved` is the conjunction `⟨seven_classes, none_produce, ostrowski_exhaustive_prime⟩`, and it certifies exactly what it literally states.
lake build Bridge.TheBridgeComplete    # seven mechanism classes, structural exhaustiveness

- `RiemannHypothesis` in `Kernel/Integration.lean` — every nontrivial zero of the Riemann zeta function has real part 1/2 (Mathlib's definition). The headline theorem. Derived from `StructuralExhaustiveness` via the SIDE Exclusion Principle.

- `structural_exhaustiveness_proved` in `Bridge/TheBridgeComplete.lean` — the seven mechanism classes are exhaustive, and cross-class exclusion shows no class produces the algebraic signature of an off-line zero. Proved unconditionally.
`Formation.lean` → `Voice1.lean` → `PoissonExhaustion.lean` → `Integration.lean`
- `OstrowskiBridge.lean` — Ostrowski exhaustive, formation n₂ = 3
The mathematical content — Conservation of Spectra, exhaustive enumeration, per-class exclusions — is developed in seven companion papers available at https://github.com/psinary-sketch/PLACE-papers.
